title: Nebula Events
description: A brand new Network focused on events and community! We have a GeoPotitical SMP and Skyblock(WIP)!
body:
Nebula Events
-----------------------------
A server network with a prime focus on unique Events!

Here is a few of our Current Gamemodes:

A Hardcore Geopolitical RPG SMP:
Ever wanted to form your own nation? Maybe Start up a new Religion? Orr maybe you just like to catch people lacking outside their claims! 
With Tailored Events on the ways and Points of Interests with lore by our own Lore and Build Teams!

Skyblock: This one is for your automating needs, If you want a custom tailored Skyblock Experience, this is for you! 
Notice: Skyblock is currently in Early Development by our very skillful Lead Developer!(Who may or may not smell like chocolate!)

With many more things to plan, we hope you will make this server your home!
